patch_description: Replace 24 independent local parameters per block with four shared parameters and expand the sparse ring into complete-graph entanglement. This aligns the ansatz with the permutation-symmetric mean-Z readout and all 28 pairwise feature channels, sharply reducing the model from 146 to 26 total parameters while improving regularization and parameter efficiency. A single central CRZ supplies a trainable asymmetric phase interaction without broadly increasing parameter count; the final shared RY layer converts the learned pairwise phases into measurable populations. This structure is supported by the prior results, where it achieved substantially higher validation accuracy and lower validation loss than the current ring ansatz.
